text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- During a joint press conference with French President Jacques Chirac and a speech in front of parliament at the end of an official visit; a common and unified vision (with Jordan) of ways to help save Middle East peace.

- King Hussein says "we are in need of France and Europe to guarantee peace and the future of the peoples in the region"; says: "we were always against any change in Jerusalem before the end of final status talks in a satisfactory manner."
- A letter delivered by PLO negotiator Shaath from Palestinian leader Arafat to King Hussein on the progress of peace talks with the Israelis.
- King Hussein meets the head of the Austrian parliament who says Jordan's role is balanced and Israel has to honour accords.
- Jordan and France: joint anxiety over the future of the peace talks and stress on the necessity of ending the plight of the Iraqi people.
- King Hussein says "will do everything we can to attain peace but not at any price." Chirac says "security is not guaranteed by force and the men of peace will ultimately prevail."
- Islamist deputies praise Chirac and call for a bigger European role in the region.
